result.headline: Actuator output ch[5] froze at 1500 us late in the flight while ch[4] and the attitude loops kept running.
result.explanation: A control fault is visible at the ch[5] output channel late in the flight, with no mode change or event around it. The recording shows the command froze but not why: output stage, mixer or logging.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[5]] was varying, then held 1500 from t=111.784 s to the end of the recording (21.233 s, 66 samples)
evidence.shows: ch[5] was held at a fixed 1500 for the last 21 s, after varying normally.

evidence.quote: CHANGE actuator.output[ch[5]] at t=25.574 s: 1458 -> 1541 us (step 83, 13.8x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: Before the freeze, ch[5] stepped together with ch[4] at t=25.574 s and t=71.821 s (lines 44-47). ch[4] stepped again at t=130.422 s (line 43); ch[5] did not.

evidence.quote: CHANGE actuator.output[ch[4]] at t=130.422 s: 1415.5 -> 1503.5 us (step 88, 12.6x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: ch[4] and ch[3] still responded after the freeze, so the control demand continued and only ch[5] stopped.

evidence.quote: ANOMALY a12 t=111.784 s: actuator.output[ch[5]] was varying, then held 1500 to the end (see line 25; strength 4.367)
evidence.shows: The only anomaly in the recording that is neither start-up nor a manoeuvre.

checked.check: compare at the freeze onset (10 s window): what changed
checked.result: ch[5] spread went from 11 to 0 and is flagged frozen_after. Roll tracking error was 0.986 deg before and 1.783 deg after (ratio 1.81). Pitch and yaw tracking did not worsen.

checked.check: window 100-133 s: ch[5] against ch[4], ch[3], roll setpoint and throttle
checked.result: ch[4] and ch[5] had identical values up to 110.825 s (1459, 1486, 1526, 1487, 1499). After that ch[5] stays at 1500 while ch[4] moves (1534, 1494, 1505, 1531, 1516, 1469, 1395, 1516). Roll setpoint and throttle keep varying.

checked.check: sequence 105-115 s: who left baseline first
checked.result: Throttle left baseline at 105.021 s, then ch[2] at 105.237 s, then ch[4] and ch[5] together at 106.222 s. Nothing preceded the freeze. No events in the window.
Only two events, both at t=0.209 s (low battery, sensor health), both start-up. No earlier cases are available.

effects.quote: SHIFT vehicle.attitude[roll] changed level for good at t=15.543 s: median 40.54 before, 2.329 after deg (6.5x its variation before)
effects.why: A manoeuvre ending long before the freeze; it is not related to ch[5].

next_action.action: Bench-test the ch[5] output and servo with props off.
next_action.why: This separates a frozen flight-controller output or mixer from a downstream servo or wiring fault, which the recorded command cannot show.
how: Download the raw flight log and check whether the commanded ch[5] value was already 1500 at the freeze time
Move the surface through the ground-station actuator test and watch ch[5] on a scope or servo tester
Swap the servo to ch[4] and the ch[4] servo to ch[5] and repeat
next_action.conditions: Aircraft disarmed, props off, on the bench, battery at normal charge, same firmware and mixer config as flight-29.
next_action.baseline: ch[4], which carried identical values until 110.825 s in cc_7 and in lines 44-47.

outcomes.label: ch[5] does not move on bench command
outcomes.means: The output stage or mixer on the flight controller is stuck, or the channel is disabled.
outcomes.then: Inspect the mixer config and firmware failsafe handling for ch[5]

outcomes.label: Output moves on the scope but the servo does not
outcomes.means: The fault is downstream: servo, connector or wiring.
outcomes.then: Inspect and replace the servo and harness

outcomes.label: Everything moves normally on the bench
outcomes.means: The freeze is intermittent or only a logging artefact.
outcomes.then: Request the raw flight log and compare to the actuator command

unknowns: Who or what commanded ch[5] to 1500 at the freeze; the recording shows no event or mode change.
Whether the physical surface stopped moving, since only the commanded output was recorded.
Whether ch[5] is the twin of ch[4]; the identical values suggest so but the sheet does not name the surfaces.

data_requests.what: Raw flight controller log with commanded actuator and mixer outputs and RC input
data_requests.window: Whole flight-29, especially the last 30 s
data_requests.why_needed: Shows whether the controller commanded ch[5] to 1500 or the value was held or lost downstream of the mixer.

unobservable.fact: Whether the servo on ch[5] physically stopped or moved
unobservable.why_it_matters: The recorded outputs are commands; servo or wiring failure cannot be seen in them.
unobservable.how_to_observe: Inspect the surface and servo and bench-test with a servo tester.

hypotheses.claim: The flight controller's ch[5] output or mixer stopped updating and held neutral 1500.
hypotheses.because: The command froze while ch[4] and the attitude loops continued; no event, mode change or other channel changed with it.

hypotheses.claim: The ch[5] servo or harness failed physically.
hypotheses.because: A downstream fault would not change the recorded command to a flat 1500; the command record never observed the servo.

hypotheses.claim: The control loops stopped demanding ch[5] movement.
hypotheses.because: Roll setpoint and ch[4] and ch[3] outputs kept varying after the freeze, so demand continued.

hypotheses.claim: Only the logged value froze while the real output kept working.
hypotheses.because: The data cannot separate a logged freeze from a real one; the raw log or bench test can.

events.what: ch[5] output held 1500 from t=111.784 s to the end
events.why: Only non-manoeuvre change in the recording; the twin channel kept moving.

events.what: Low-voltage and sensor-health warnings at t=0.209 s
events.why: Start-up messages with nothing later pointing back to them.

events.what: Tracking mismatches at start-up and during manoeuvres
events.why: Start-up transients and manoeuvres; none lines up with the freeze.

events.what: Roll setpoint and attitude level shift at 13-15 s
events.why: A manoeuvre ending; attitude followed the setpoint 2.2 s later.

result.lesson: No earlier cases are available for comparison.
result.reuse_when: Aircraft with paired control-surface outputs where one channel holds exactly its neutral PWM (1500 us) while its twin keeps varying, with no events or mode change.
